title: Sex Ed
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael Scott grapples with the possibility that he has herpes, leading to awkward conversations with past partners and coworkers. Dwight takes on a zealous role in investigating Michael's sexual history and insists on notifying all potentially affected individuals. Meanwhile, Andy attempts to educate the office on sexual health and kindness, using humor and frank discussions to address stigma. The episode also features various comedic moments including Dwight's antics with day laborers and a hornet's nest, and Michael's humorous interactions with Holly and Jan as they reflect on past relationships.
